title: Cell-cell communication network-based interpretable machine learning predicts cancer patient response to immune checkpoint inhibitors.
summary: Interpretable machine learning on patient cell-cell communication networks predicted immune-checkpoint-inhibitor response across independent bulk and single-cell cohorts.
ai_technology: Materials and Methods describe network construction and cohort analyses; Results report response prediction across nine bulk and two single-cell cohorts.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Interpretable machine learning on patient cell-cell communication networks predicted immune-checkpoint-inhibitor response across independent bulk and single-cell cohorts.
evidence.unknown: Independent bulk and single-cell cohorts support predictive associations, not causal cell-cell mechanisms or prospective treatment-selection benefit.
evidence.ai_role: Materials and Methods describe network construction and cohort analyses; Results report response prediction across nine bulk and two single-cell cohorts.
